original.target_description: Experiment 2: predicted next-period versus remembered last-period unpleasantness

n.quote: We excluded 2 participants from the analyses: one who did not report her current emotion and one who did not report how unpleasant her previous period was (resulting N⫽49).
n.exclusions: Two of 51 excluded: missing current emotion or previous-period unpleasantness.

n.sample_role: participants by anticipation and retrospection condition, respectively; printed group counts
n.exclusions: General funneling removed two participants unable to mentally time travel and two unable to write about a scenario (p. 38). Main results explicitly described as pre-exclusion on p. 37; subsequent supplementary exclusions are not applied to these printed tests.

reported_success.quote: In terms of intensity of emotion, we found no empirical support for the asymmetry in all three scenarios.

notes: Extracted by neutral outcome description; supplied replication page locators interchange current emotion (DV1, p. 40) and predicted/remembered emotion (DV2, p. 41). No values converted. Replication main tables report pre-exclusion analyses, apart from general funneling. Authors describe absence of support for asymmetry; this is their narrative verdict even though original unpleasantness contrast was also nonsignificant.
